findings.highlight: I unconsciously find myself watching her.
findings.evidenceJa: 他にやる事がなかったからか、それとも、無意識に目が追ってしまうのか
findings.governingReading: The narrator wonders whether he has nothing else to do or his eyes follow her unconsciously.
findings.explanation: Two possible reasons for watching Sakura collapse into unconscious watching.

findings.highlight: Sakura always looks nervous when she first picks up a knife
findings.evidenceJa: 包丁をいれる時、桜はどんな物でもそんなふうに緊張して
findings.governingReading: 包丁をいれる時 concerns making the cut into any ingredient, after she already firmly holds the knife in8.
findings.explanation: Tension at the initial knife cut becomes tension when picking up a knife.
